contract: The displayed v1 regret, which sums T objectives but subtracts the entropic comparator once, must obey the displayed high-probability RHS for every admissible instance.

verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: An admissible OT instance has an action-independent lower bound on printed regret above a uniform upper bound on the full theorem RHS.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED: The literal definition and theorem inequality are proved together.
